name: Surrealism, a supplemental design reference rather than a directly named source-collection style. An unusual scene is not automatically Surrealism.
visualIdentity: Explicit: impossible scales, object relationships, or gravity placed inside convincing space and lighting. One coherent dream logic, photorealistic or painterly. Transformations unfold calmly, preserving composition and narrative continuity.
suitableUses: Explicit: single dreamlike images, or hybrids when a camera journey or staged composition carries the narrative. Inferred fits, not confirmed by the source: brand films, music videos, narrative openers, and poster-like art campaigns.
limitations: Avoid when the scene lacks coherent dream logic. Avoid rushed transformations, hidden cuts, camera intersecting geometry, generic pastel grading, busy prop clutter, and mixed rendering styles. Dense reading during travel conflicts with one-shot or continuous-shot requirements.
palette: Unsupplied authored example only: background #EDE5D7, foreground #302D35, accent_1 #617C8B, accent_2 #B26E51. Supplied or approved palettes override these. Keep discrete; gradients are disabled. Background and foreground reach 10.815:1 for normal text. Accents are decorative only, at 3.524 and 3.377. Recheck composited frames.
motionAndInteraction: Camera movement and deformation are driven by keyframes or cached simulation, with calm transformations. Video derives all state from seekable composition time. Live scroll or pointer behavior applies only to interactive delivery. Optional catalog references (motion-002, -005, -012, -015) apply only when the scene supports them; choosing none is valid.
audio: Unspecified by the source; no mandatory audio layer. Topic-dependent options include background music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence. Honor explicit user audio and supplied assets first. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, absence of clipping, and picture synchronization.
assetRequirements: Unspecified: no assets, exact copy, duration, aspect ratio, resolution, or frame rate supplied; subject placeholders remain unresolved. Needed: prepared models, materials, and lighting for impossible scenes. Blender with bundled Python bpy and Cycles or EEVEE can produce them. Load local fonts and assets before rendering.
combinations: Source suggests two hybrids. style-099 adds a continuous camera path through impossible spaces, keeping one dream logic, consistent lighting, and no hidden cuts. style-104 adds frontal symmetrical staging with slow push-in on a centered axis. Fit is inferred from the stated rationale.
productionApproach: Blender with bpy and Cycles or EEVEE owns visuals and motion. HyperFrames is the primary pipeline for composition, timing, sync, checks, snapshots, and render. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, with the reason recorded. chroma.js validates colors. Verify key frames, full video, dimensions, frame rate, and audio sync.
